failure_rule: First HTTP failure or source/repository drift stops collection without retry and makes confirmatory claims void.

public_derivative.spec_sha256_note: spec_sha256 still commits to the private original's core. It does not revalidate against this transformed file, and no collector should be asked to reload this derivative.

schedule_note: Four seven-query groups use a balanced Williams square; each cell occupies every temporal position and every directed carry-over pair once. Within-subblock query order is rotated.
scope_rule: The twelve high-rate line facts are tailored to the frozen questions. No cell may ship without a target-independent heldout corpus, a full-tree token budget, and confirmation under Sable's deployed sampler.
sentinel_rule: Any normalized Q01 or Q25 replay mismatch makes the batch descriptive-only.
